senses.gloss: m. (preced.) a row of vines in a vineyard.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:1:2">Y. Kil. IV, beg. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>נסב חד כ׳</he> if the owner took away one of the five rows.—Pl. <cite ref="K01232"><he>כַּרְמִין</he></cite> (prob. to be read: <he>כַּרְמוֹנִין</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:1:2">Ib.</cite> <he>תלתא כ׳ ותרי ביניין</he> three rows and two intervals.
